title: RLS Contact Vocabulary
description: Address-book fields for items representing a personal or professional contact. Complements person/v1 (which covers profile identity) with structured contact-book data: name parts for sorting, organization and job title, multiple email addresses and phone numbers, website and postal address.

givenName.description: Given name (Vorname). Used for sorting and display.

familyName.description: Family name (Nachname). Required. Used as the primary sort key and as the activation field for the address-book module.

organization.description: Company or organization the contact is affiliated with.

jobTitle.description: Role or position within the organization.

email.description: One or more email addresses. Order is significant; the first entry is the primary.

phone.description: One or more phone numbers. Order is significant; the first entry is the primary. Formatting is not enforced.

website.description: URL of the contact's personal or professional website. Same semantics as project/v1 website.

streetAddress.description: Street and house number as a single line.

country.description: Country name in the writer's language, e.g. Deutschland.
